page_title: UDI 3-3 VER | Udinese v Verona 03/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+7' 3 - 3 Goal! Cyril Ngonge swings the ball deep into the box and finds Thomas Henry (Verona) unmarked, and his close-range header flies past the keeper into the roof of the net. 3:3.
90+5' Michael Folorunsho (Verona) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post!
90+4' The current number of shots on goal is 6:3.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' Thomas Henry (Verona) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Fabio Maresca had an easy-decision to make.
88' Gabriele Cioffi has decided to substitute Jordan Zemura and he is replaced by Hassane Kamara (Udinese).
87' We are about to witness a subsitution. Kingsley Ehizibue (Udinese) for Martin Payero.
85' Ondrej Duda (Verona) takes the corner which is cleared.
84' Substitution. Darko Lazovic is replaced by Thomas Henry (Verona).
82' Cyril Ngonge (Verona) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
80' Verona couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Marco Silvestri (Udinese) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
80' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) hits a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a comfortable save for Lorenzo Montipo as it's directed low at the middle of the goal.
79' Milan Djuric will be replaced by Federico Bonazzoli (Verona).
79' Walace (Udinese) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Fabio Maresca blows his whistle for a foul.
78' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) takes a shot from outside the box and hits the left post!
75' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the right post!
74' Filippo Terracciano (Verona) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
74' Walace (Udinese) commits a rough challenge and Fabio Maresca blows his whistle for a foul.

72' 3 - 2 The ball hits the back of the net! Florian Thauvin showcases his brilliant technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) gets onto the scoresheet by sweetly heading it low inside the left post – 3:2.
71' Cyril Ngonge (Verona) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.
71' Tomas Suslov (Verona) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort.
67' We are about to witness a substitution. Florian Thauvin (Udinese) is replacing Roberto Pereyra.
66' Gabriele Cioffi decides to make a substitution. Festy Ebosele will be replaced by Sandi Lovric (Udinese).
65' Roberto Pereyra (Udinese) wins himself enough space to meet the resulting corner and fires the ball at goal, but the keeper does well to stop his effort.
65' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
64' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
61' 2 - 2 What a goal that is! Tomas Suslov sends a brilliant cross into the box and Cyril Ngonge (Verona) scores a stunning bicycle kick goal! Wow, take a bow gentlemen. 2:2.
59' Roberto Pereyra (Udinese) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
58' Roberto Pereyra (Udinese) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
58' The players claim that Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) handled the ball and it seems they are right.
56' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
55' Roberto Pereyra (Udinese) takes the resulting corner which is well defended. Udinese have been awarded a corner kick.
53' Lorenzo Montipo leaps to intercept the corner kick from Lazar Samardzic (Udinese).
53' Verona have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
50' Diego Coppola (Verona) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
49' Cyril Ngonge (Verona) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
47' Fabio Maresca blows his whistle as Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
46' Referee Fabio Maresca blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+6' The end of the first half.
45+4' Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass.
45+4' Bruno Amione (Verona) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
45+3' Michael Folorunsho (Verona) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
45+1' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Martin Payero (Udinese) was quite harsh and Fabio Maresca didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
44' Filippo Terracciano (Verona) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
44' Jordan Zemura (Udinese) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
43' Fabio Maresca interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Jordan Zemura (Udinese). Verona will take a free kick.

43' Milan Djuric (Verona) controls the ball from the resulting free kick on the edge of the box and releases a strike that could have ended up low in the middle of the goal but for a magnificent save by Marco Silvestri.
42' It seemed like Filippo Terracciano (Verona) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
42' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Lazar Samardzic (Udinese). Fabio Maresca saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
41' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) is able to continue to play.
39' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) picks up an injury.
37' 2 - 1 Goal! Milan Djuric (Verona) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Marco Silvestri into the bottom left corner.
36' Milan Djuric (Verona) is going to take the penalty!
36' Christian Kabasele (Udinese) touches the ball with his hand inside the box! PENALTY to Verona! Let's see who will take responsibility.
35' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent.
34' Cyril Ngonge (Verona) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
33' Festy Ebosele (Udinese) brings an opponent down and Fabio Maresca interrupts the game.

30' 2 - 0 Roberto Pereyra sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) latches on to it and finishes with a quick shot into the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 2:0.
28' Verona seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
24' A precise low pass is received by Tomas Suslov (Verona), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.
24' Festy Ebosele (Udinese) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
23' Fabio Maresca blows his whistle for a foul after Martin Payero (Udinese) hacks down one of his opponents.
21' The corner is bent into the box and met with a firm header by Diego Coppola (Verona), but it's just over the bar.
21' Ondrej Duda (Verona) prepares to take a corner kick.
18' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) is forced to stop his forward run after being caught in an offside position by the linesman.
16' 1 - 0 Lazar Samardzic sends a cross in from the free kick. Christian Kabasele (Udinese) wins the ball and smashes it into the bottom left corner, increasing the score to 1:0.
16' It seemed like Lazar Samardzic (Udinese) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.

16' It looks like Filippo Terracciano (Verona) saw red with that tackle. Fabio Maresca won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Free kick. Udinese will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
14' Michael Folorunsho (Verona) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
13' Michael Folorunsho (Verona) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
13' Filippo Terracciano (Verona) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
12' Christian Kabasele (Udinese) jumps for a header from the corner kick, but fails to steer the ball into the goal as it flies high over the bar.
12' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Udinese.

12' Martin Payero (Udinese) takes a good touch to control a cross on the edge of the box and shoots towards the left post, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block his effort. Udinese have a corner.
8' Festy Ebosele (Udinese) is penalised for a foul. Fabio Maresca had a clear view and blows his whistle.
7' Isaac Success is being substituted because of an injury. Gabriele Cioffi sends Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) on the pitch.
6' Milan Djuric (Verona) argues strongly with the referee and is awarded a yellow card. A needless yellow card!
5' Isaac Success (Udinese) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
2' Bruno Amione (Verona) commits a rough challenge and Fabio Maresca blows his whistle for an infringement.
2' Darko Lazovic (Verona) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
1' The first half has just begun.
Verona will kick-off.
